basis: Explicit owner instruction: EI18 every required hardware component is simulated required hardware; EI04 template/generic assets may be used in all cases and classes derive from associated standards.
standardAssetCoverageRule: Enumerate every asset class defined by each associated applicable standard and provide templates; record standards defining no asset taxonomy explicitly; preserve cross-standard distinctions with traceable mappings.
evidenceRule: Real software, cryptography, model/adapter/engine execution and authentic admission/reviewer evidence are required. Simulated device-state readback is valid simulation evidence; mock receipts and TEST_ONLY workflow rehearsals cannot substitute for genuine admission.
completionState: Asset templates and simulator catalog are future EI04/EI18 deliverables, not created or validated by publishing this backlog.
physicalDeployment: Separate future field requirements; physical procurement, CHIL/PHIL laboratories, customer records and physical commissioning do not gate corpus admission.
